procedure.method: Read only the explicitly supplied pinned inputs. Verified their byte counts/SHA-256 and read the five pinned native-evidence manifests without following embedded paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so there were no additional source assets or protected-layout manifests to inspect. Actually rendered and visually inspected each exact PNG using tools.view_image through functions.exec, requesting detail=original: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2 in those three views; then M3; then M4; then M5. Each of the fifteen required renders was returned and inspected before the first transcription judgment or image/set score. Native dimensions were independently read from the PNG IHDR headers. After completing all fifteen views and making the first raw transcription, a genuine M1 URL dash-class ambiguity triggered one further view_image of the same pinned M1 native file. Both reads are retained in its transcription record; this additional revisit is not an extra required packet view. No source was regenerated, cropped or edited. No peer review, maker inspection, unlisted file or external page was read. No agents were spawned/forked/resumed. No runtime thread ID is claimed; the runner owns provenance.

ai_slop.location: Title framing curve and detached upper-right tool
